reports.title: Handbook on Residential Property Prices Indices (RPPIs)
reports.publisher: Eurostat, ILO, IMF, OECD, UNECE and the World Bank
reports.description: The international methodological handbook for residential property (house) price indices, 2013 edition, published by Eurostat (catalogue KS-RA-12-022) and copyrighted jointly by the European Union, the International Labour Organization, the International Monetary Fund, the OECD, the UN Economic Commission for Europe and the World Bank. It covers the uses of RPPIs, stratification, hedonic regression, repeat-sales and appraisal-based methods, the land/structures split, data sources and recommendations. The publisher's own title spells it 'Prices Indices'; citing documents usually write 'Price Indices'. Minted 2026-10-17 as the hub of the housing research lane.
reports.cadence_note: One edition so far (2013); 0.05 is a once-a-generation revision rate written as a number.
title_aliases: Handbook on Residential Property Price Indices

reports.title: Residential Property Price Index
reports.description: Ireland's monthly index of house and apartment price inflation for households buying on the open market. First published in March 2011 (backdated to January 2005); since September 2016 it is compiled from stamp duty returns covering the whole residential market, using a hedonic regression. The CSO's quality report (SIMS 2024) lists the Handbook on Residential Property Price Indices under its methodology documentation and states the CSO has adopted the standards of Regulation (EU) 2016/792.

dependencies.basis: SELF-DECLARED: RESEARCHED 2026-10-17 (housing lane 0a step 1).
